summary: FERC's Secretary issues an errata notice correcting the caption and footnote 11 of the E-8 MISO show cause order, so Wabash Valley Power Association is listed among entities not required to respond as Transmission Owners.

points.point: The caption wrongly included Wabash Valley Power Association, and footnote 11 omitted it.
points.quote: The caption in the order inadvertently included “Wabash Valley Power Association, Inc.” and footnote 11 inadvertently omitted “Wabash Valley Power Association, Inc.”

points.point: The notice deletes Wabash from the caption and adds it to footnote 11.
points.quote: This errata notice hereby corrects the caption as shown above, by deleting “Wabash Valley Power Association, Inc.”

points.point: FERC keeps authority to review non-public-utility entities' formula rates as part of MISO's Tariff.
points.quote: the Commission retains the authority to review each entity’s formula rates as a component of MISO’s Tariff in an order to show cause directed towards MISO

throughLine.text: Corrects who counts as a Transmission Owner that must respond to the E-8 show cause order; MISO itself must still respond about non-public utilities' Tariff provisions.
